types.label: Strike
types.definition: Explicit aerial, missile, drone or artillery strike. Do not infer a weapon from a blast.

types.label: Armed attack
types.definition: Shooting, assault or an armed attack with unspecified weapon; not unexplained noise.

types.label: Explosion
types.definition: A blast whose armed cause or weapon is not established.

types.label: Air defence
types.definition: Interception or air-defence engagement; not the mere presence of an aircraft.

types.label: Weapons launch
types.definition: A reported missile, rocket or drone launch, without inventing an impact.

types.label: Territorial change
types.definition: Capture, recapture or loss of control of a place; movement alone is insufficient.

types.label: Deployment
types.definition: Deployment, reinforcement or withdrawal of forces.

types.label: Military activity
types.definition: Military patrol, flight, naval activity or exercise; no attack inferred. Civil flights are not military.

types.label: Maritime interdiction
types.definition: Vessel seizure, boarding, enforced diversion or blockade; cumulative counts are one aggregate report.

types.label: Security alert
types.definition: A concrete warning or alert being issued or raised; the warned-about attack is not confirmed.

types.label: All clear
types.definition: An alert being lifted, not proof an attack occurred.

types.label: Evacuation
types.definition: An evacuation order or evacuation, preserving planned versus completed status.

types.label: Rescue
types.definition: Search, rescue or recovery operation; casualty figures alone are not a new event.

types.label: Fire
types.definition: A fire; do not infer its cause.

types.label: Protest
types.definition: A demonstration, riot or civil protest; political opinion alone is not a protest.

types.label: Infrastructure disruption
types.definition: Power, water, communications or other service outage; damage alone does not prove an outage.

types.label: Structural damage
types.definition: Damage, destruction or collapse of buildings, bridges or other structures; does not establish cause or service outage.

types.label: Transport disruption
types.definition: Road, airport, port, border or transport closure, reopening or interruption.

types.label: Accident
types.definition: A concrete transport, industrial or other accident, without assigning intent.

types.label: Natural hazard
types.definition: Earthquake, flood, storm or other natural hazard. A forecast remains planned/unclear.

types.label: Diplomatic contact
types.definition: A concrete official meeting, visit, call or negotiation; future meetings remain planned.

types.label: Agreement
types.definition: Agreement, ceasefire or deal being reached, implemented or broken; talks alone are not an agreement.

types.label: Sanctions
types.definition: Imposition, removal or change of sanctions or embargoes; diplomatic disapproval alone is not sanctions.

types.label: Policy change
types.definition: A concrete government decision, restriction, regulation or administrative change; general rhetoric is not an event.

types.label: Arrest or detention
types.definition: Arrest, detention, release or prisoner exchange; an allegation alone is not an arrest.

types.label: Legal proceeding
types.definition: A charge, trial, judgment or sentence; preserve allegations and jurisdiction.

types.label: Election
types.definition: Voting, election results, appointment or transfer of office; campaigning commentary alone is not an event.

types.label: Aid operation
types.definition: A concrete humanitarian delivery or relief operation; a promise remains planned.

types.label: Cyber incident
types.definition: An explicitly reported intrusion or cyberattack; an unexplained outage is not a cyberattack.

types.label: Other event
types.definition: A concrete occurrence outside this vocabulary. Never use it to force commentary, promotion or media-only content into Events.
